seo.title: Programs
seo.description: CCD programs serving Irvington and Baltimore's 21229.

hero.title: Built by the block,
hero.body: CCD programs turn cooperative dues and partner support into practical services, food access, tools, training, and neighborhood events.
hero.alt: Clean and Green crew member at work beside the We Can mural

sections.title: Community Co-op Market
sections.body: The market brings produce, local vendors, music, membership sign-ups, and neighborhood energy to Frederick Avenue. It previews the year-round co-op grocery planned for the Center for Social Impact.

sections.title: The Tool Bank
sections.body: Resident members can borrow tools for home repairs, garden work, and block projects. It is a practical way to make ownership cheaper and collective.

sections.title: The 4th Brew
sections.body: CCD's coffee brand, and the programme behind it. Roasting and selling coffee is how CCD trains people in a real business — buying, branding, packing, selling — and the margin comes back to the block. Learn how it works, then buy a bag from The 4th Brew's own shop.
sections.alt: Roasted coffee beans for The 4th Brew

sections.title: Workforce development
sections.body: CCD connects training to actual neighborhood work: landscaping, facilities, events, media, market operations, and cooperative business skills. The 4th Brew, CCD's own coffee brand, teaches the roasting and retail trades - and DeWalt backs the construction side.
sections.alt: Youth crew tending raised beds at the community farm training site
